prediction_unit_description: A unique (visitor, item, session) combination where an add-to-cart event occurred

target.definition: 1 if no transaction for (visitor, item) within 24h after prediction_timestamp, else 0

timestamp_column.name: prediction_timestamp
timestamp_column.description: Unix timestamp (ms) of the first add-to-cart event for this unit

features.name: hist_views
features.description: Total view events by this visitor before prediction_timestamp
features.ui_tooltip: Number of product views by this visitor before the cart event

features.name: hist_addtocarts
features.description: Total add-to-cart events by this visitor before or at prediction_timestamp
features.ui_tooltip: Number of add-to-cart actions by this visitor (includes current)

features.name: hist_transactions
features.description: Total transaction events by this visitor before prediction_timestamp
features.ui_tooltip: Number of completed purchases by this visitor before this cart event

features.name: hist_unique_items
features.description: Number of unique items this visitor interacted with before prediction_timestamp
features.ui_tooltip: Distinct products this visitor interacted with

features.name: session_views
features.description: View events in the current session up to prediction_timestamp
features.ui_tooltip: Product views in the current browsing session

features.name: session_addtocarts
features.description: Add-to-cart events in the current session up to prediction_timestamp
features.ui_tooltip: Items added to cart in this session

features.name: session_unique_items
features.description: Unique items interacted with in the current session
features.ui_tooltip: Distinct products browsed in this session

features.name: session_duration_sec
features.description: Duration of the current session in seconds up to prediction_timestamp
features.ui_tooltip: How long the visitor has been browsing in this session

features.name: hist_conversion_rate
features.description: Ratio of historical transactions to historical add-to-carts for this visitor
features.ui_tooltip: Past purchase completion rate for this visitor (0.0 to 1.0)

features.name: categoryid
features.description: Category ID of the item (-1 if unknown)

features.name: parent_categoryid
features.description: Parent category ID from category tree (-1 if unknown)

features.name: num_available_properties
features.description: Count of item properties available at prediction time
features.ui_tooltip: Number of product attributes available at prediction time
